A layout table renders its rows as list items, and those markers honour the bullets option like any other list

```elixir title="Elixir"
options_value = %HtmlToMarkdown.ConversionOptions{bullets: "*+-"}
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<table><tr><td>alpha</td><td>beta</td></tr><tr><td>a</td><td>b</td><td>c</td></tr></table>", options_value)
IO.inspect(result.content)
```
